en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a rural riverside landscape surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground are scattered farm buildings and fenced fields. Near the center stands a white church with a tall, slender spire. Across the river are more fields and wooded slopes. Printed Norwegian captions appear at the bottom, with additional handwritten greetings in cursive.
